constraints.title: Practice
constraints.paraphrase: Practice is a fixed block from 5:30 to 7:00 pm every weekday.

questions: Is "practice" a fixed outside commitment (like a team or band practice), or do you mean your guitar practice that Friday should schedule for you at 5:30 to 7 on weekdays?
